integrity_note: Explicit geometric proof and two reproducible finite checking programs; no independent scientific audit or certification has been performed.
limitations: Non-singleton stable classes are not classified.
No optimal refinement-round bound is claimed.
Finite computations are corroboration, not an infinite proof.
Earlier specialized coverage cannot be ruled out.
scientific_scope: Finite Desarguesian affine planes \(\operatorname{AG}(2,\mathbb F_q)\), \(q=p^e\), with distinct individually coloured point marks containing three noncollinear points; exact singleton stable colour classes and minimum number of point marks.
title: Subfield recovery by colour refinement in finite affine incidence planes
